people.name: Donald Trump

issues.midterm_loss: First said he wasn't on the ballot and blamed weak candidates and Fox News; by Nov 8 (60 Minutes) blamed the war, dislike of Israel and bad economic messaging.
issues.trump: Doubled down: named Stephen Miller chief of staff (Nov 6), said he'll keep Hegseth, displayed a VETO hat, staying out of House leader race. Called Vance's diagnosis largely true. Nov 8: Vance's comments didn't hurt their relationship, but "a lot of people didn't like his comments. But not me."
issues.iran_war: Conceded the war and higher gas prices hurt, but gave an "emphatic yes" when asked if he'd do it again.
issues.israel: Election Day (Fox & Friends): said the ~$4B in annual military aid ends this year. Nov 8 (60 Minutes): said a "great dislike" of Israel contributed to the losses.

people.other_themes: Called Massie a "low life"; blamed Democrats for the post-election stock drop. Nov 9: called the Iran war "militarily … effectively over" and suggested without evidence that voting machines were to blame. Endorsed RNC chair Gruters for another term (Nov 6)
people.sources: Truth Social posts and press remarks, Nov 4–8; CBS 60 Minutes, Nov 8; Times of Israel, Nov 4; The Hill via The National Desk, Nov 8–11

trump_alignment.note: Defines the axis (+2). Doubling down on personnel (Miller, Hegseth) and on the war.

economic.note: Far populist: tariffs and industrial policy are his signature. No change.

israel.stance: Pro-Israel, now hedging: announced the end of aid and named dislike of Israel as a cause of the loss.
